reviews.name: Jared Gunn
reviews.text: SurfYogaBeer exceeded every expectation and delivered one of the best travel experiences I've ever had on the Amalfi Coast. From unforgettable boat days exploring Capri, Positano, and Amalfi to hiking, yoga, cliff jumping, wine tasting near Mount Vesuvius, and incredible Italian food, every day was perfectly planned and completely stress-free. The hosts created an amazing atmosphere that made it easy to connect with everyone in the group, and the farewell Black Tie by the Sea celebration was the perfect way to end an unforgettable week. If you're looking for a trip that combines adventure, relaxation, breathtaking scenery, and lifelong memories, I can't recommend SurfYogaBeer enough.

reviews.name: Amy Rivera
reviews.text: Just got back from the Amalfi trip and WHAT A DREAM not just bc of the beautiful places we got to see but for the people I met, true friendships were formed and our leaders Sam Nikki Carrie and Adam were just amazing always looking out for us but also vibing with us and hiping us up the hole time probably see you in Nicaragua on NYE

reviews.name: Ami Sidhu
reviews.text: Just got back from the SYB amalfi trip and can honestly say it was the best trip I’ve ever been on. reviews.name: Victoria Barrett
reviews.text: I just returned from SYB's Amalfi Coast Trip. This was my first trip with SYB and will definitely be returning. It's hard to put into words how much this trip, the experiences and the friends I made meant to me. All four of the leaders for this trip (Sam, Nikki, Carri, and Adam) all did an amazing job at making sure that we all felt welcome and included. Many of us started this trip as strangers and within a week I am looking forward to seeing so many of these people throughout the rest of my life. Whether I meet them on more SYB trips or on simple weekend trips, I will always appreciate that SYB brought us all together. If you are thinking about taking a trip with SYB.... Don't Think, Just Do It. You will not regret it.

reviews.name: Jacklyn Adams
reviews.text:
Second SYB trip in the books and Nicaragua was a TIME! Also so gorgeous! If you’re a sunset lover like me you’ll fall in love.

Quick recap of the itinerary: ATV’d (everywhere), rode horseback at sunrise, went deep-sea fishing, explored a local town, hit a karaoke bar, surfed daily, and even summited a shark-fin-shaped rock (see pics!)

I think what I love about Surf Yoga Beer is how easy they make everything. You seriously just show up and enjoy. The itinerary is thoughtful and the vibes are immaculate. It’s very clear they’ve done this many times!

I’m already booked for my next SYB adventure in Kenya with friends I met on a previous trip (check out Amalfi too 😉). If you want unforgettable memories and real connections, this is it. Don’t think, just do!

reviews.name: Timothy Dunn
reviews.text:
My first Surf Yoga Beer trip was Iceland in 2025, and since then I’ve been back again and again: Croatia, the Dolomites, Val Thorens, the Amalfi Coast, and the South of France. I think that says more than any review ever could.

Every trip has been completely different, but one thing has remained consistent: exceptional people, outstanding leadership, and experiences that exceed every expectation. Mantas, Bradford, Eli, Steph, and the entire SYB team have built something that’s incredibly difficult to replicate. They don’t just organize trips—they create an environment where strangers quickly become friends and unforgettable memories happen naturally.

The itineraries are always excellent, but they’re honestly the least important part of the experience. What makes Surf Yoga Beer special is the community. The people you meet, the friendships you build, and the moments that happen between the planned activities are what keep me coming back.

After six trips, I can confidently say this is one of the best decisions I’ve ever made for travel. If you’re on the fence, stop overthinking it. Book the trip. You’ll understand why so many people come back year after year.

reviews.name: Loren Ball
reviews.text: Just attended a trip to Amalfi with SYB. The itinerary was perfect and it honestly was the best week of my life. Great vibes, great leaders, new friends. I cannot wait to attend my next trip with SYB!

reviews.name: Chase Drews
reviews.text: Just got home from my SYB trip to The Amalfi Coast and it was hands down the best trip I have been on to date. The leaders made this trip incredible and they brought the energy. I went on this trip not knowing anyone and I walked away with 30+ new friends. Will 100% be booking another trip. Don't think just do!

reviews.name: Alisa Pallitto
reviews.text: Surf Yoga Beer allowed me to experience what I honestly can refer to as the happiest week of my life. I went to SYB Amalfi this past June, stepping out of my comfort zone and going completely solo. This was my first experience solo traveling and Steph, Mantas, Molly, and Chuko, along with the 41 other group members made the experience one I will never forget. I can’t say enough good things about the positive environment that was created, one that allowed each and every person to feel welcome, loved, and appreciated. This is a travel group that emphasizes the importance of building meaningful relationships and I am so grateful to have gotten to experience that. I was already thinking about which SYB adventure would be next the second I got back home! I don’t have a single regret regarding this trip and would go back in a heartbeat; don’t think just do!

reviews.name: Alex Harasty
reviews.text:
1. Destination / Activities

The location for home base on the Amalfi coast was perfect — the little fishing village we stayed in was beautiful and made it feel like we had the whole place to ourselves. The hotel staff even came out to party with us a couple nights even as they scolded us in the morning for being too rowdy in the lobby. We did manage to do the most important touristy things (Pompeii) but in a way that got us to skip lines and any logistical hurdles involved with 50,000 people trying to stampede their way through a 2000 year old archeological dig. The only hesitation you should have with anything on the trip is, if you get motion sick, get as much dramamine and motion sickness patches into your suitcase as you can. The roads are narrow, winding, and mountainous, and the water in the Mediterranean can be as choppy as it is beautiful.

2. Workouts

As a fitness coach who does not usually traffic in high fives and upbeat vibes, I was concerned that my generally surly approach to exercise was going to keep me from enjoying the workouts. Admittedly, I was a little drunk for the first one, but Mantas’ combination of soul cycle / functional fitness put me at ease right away. Be warned - if he says that the hike is just ‘a little walk’, don’t believe him, prepare for war. As for the yoga, even if you never end up on a SYB trip, you should absolutely find a way to take a yoga class with Molly.

3. Leaders

Of all the solo travel companies out there, this is really where SYB cannot be matched. Steph’s ability to sense the energy of the group, decide whether it needs a pick me up, and still keep track of all the tasks needed to keep 40 people fed/transported/housed is absolutely staggering. There isn’t a lunch table in the world where she couldn’t sit down and immediately make everyone else around her feel more comfortable with themselves or sharing parts of themselves with near strangers. Mantas, despite probably sleeping the least, exercising the most, and still having to run the rest of the business during the trip never showed a single sign of fatigue or frustration. Chuko took the 3 best photos of me ever taken. Molly went from a total stranger to giving me some of the most needed life advice I have ever received in the course of 3 days. If you trust nothing else from SYB, trust that the people in charge of your trip will be people you’ll admire and be a better person having met them.

reviews.name: S Sebor
reviews.text: Summer of 2023, I embarked on an unforgettable journey with Surf Yoga Beer to the stunning Amalfi Coast, and let me tell you, it was nothing short of magical! From heart-pumping workouts to breathtaking day trips, SYB delivered an experience that exceeded all my expectations. The highlight of our adventure was undoubtedly the boat day. Picture this: crystal-clear waters, a gentle breeze, and a group of newfound friends laughing and dancing on deck. We explored hidden coves, swam in secluded bays, and soaked up the Mediterranean sun. It was pure bliss, and I felt like I was living in a postcard. But here’s the real magic: the people. I made lifelong friends during this adventure—like-minded people who shared my love for adventure, fitness, and wine. We still keep in touch, planning future trips together. SYB created a space where strangers became family, and I’m forever grateful.

reviews.name: meghan wojtkiewicz
reviews.text: GO AHEAD AND BOOK IT. I went on Surf Yoga Beer’s trip to Amalfi and loved every second of it. From morning workouts to wine tasting to boat days to an amazing tour of Pompeii, I had an amazing time and made lifelong friends (we’ve already booked our next SYB trip together). SYB is the trip of a lifetime with likeminded people - and the perfect balance of workouts and fun. Can’t recommend it enough!

reviews.name: Harim Jeong
reviews.text: SYB Amalfi was an experience that exceeded my expectations. The itinerary that’s so thoughtfully put together blends every aspect of travel that makes the week so fulfilling - themed parties with a dj, boat rides, challenging but non intimidating workouts, the best food with scenic views, and a group of people who simply know how to have a good time! If you’re on the fence just book a trip you won’t regret it.

reviews.name: Mary Kate Gorman
reviews.text: I am a huge fan of SYB.  I attended the summer 2022 Amalfi Coast trip and had a blast - great friends, great food, great fun.  Looking forward to the Chamonix trip.  Can't recommend enough, wish I found this community sooner. xo

reviews.name: Melissa
reviews.text: okay so I am new to solo traveling and spontaneously decided I wanted to go to the Amalfi Coast this summer. I heard about Surf Yoga Beer from a friend and decided to send it! I’m so glad that I did. Not only did I make 27 new friends and the best memories, but I finally got to check off a place that has been on my bucket list forever. HOWEVER, the best part of this trip is hands down the leaders. Mantas, Steph, & Heather made this trip so memorable & fun. I loved how much they went out of their way to make sure everyone was comfortable and having a great time. Especially if people were shy they were sure to bring them out of their shell and make sure everyone felt included. The accommodations were BEAUTIFUL. The vibes were VIBING. The workouts absolutely kicked my butt, but in the best way possible. SYB does the best job at blending fun, adventure, fitness, and wholesome bonding moments. It’s kinda crazy because this trip was a week long, but you bond so deeply with your crew and new friends that it feels like y’all have known each other for months. If you’re even remotely considering going on an SYB trip, don’t hesitate! Just do it!! Life is short. Make some dope memories

reviews.name: Meredith Manning
reviews.text: A friend told me about their amazing experience doing SYB and when I saw the opportunity to go to the Amalfi Coast I knew I just had to try it! Fast forward a week later and I am sunkissed with 27 new best friends. Mantas and Steph planned every day with amazing activities and not a moment left to waste. Who knew days spent boating on the water and eating gelato could bring you so close together?! If you are looking to travel, meet new friends and go to an amazing destination SYB is definitely for you!

reviews.name: Sarah Catenac
reviews.text:
I just returned from SurfYogaBeer Amalfi, and it was the trip of a lifetime. The leaders were incredible and did a great job planning everything.

I came on this trip with one friend but left with 28. Everyone was like-minded, very welcoming, AND knows how to have a good time! We are already planning which trip to go on next.

If you're debating on booking... DO IT. It's an experience you will hold on to for a lifetime.

reviews.name: Nathalie Jolain
reviews.text:
10/10 Will book another trip!

Summer of 2022 I wanted to take a trip to Europe but knew it would require a lot of time and planning.. A friend of mine had taken a trip in 2016 to  the Amalfi Coast in Italy with Surf Yoga Beer and I remember her saying "it was a life changing experience!"

With one month until their 2023 Amalfi Italy Trip - I reached out and said to myself "if there is a spot, I'm going!" Sure enough, I was lucky to get a spot and one month later I met a group of 45 strangers at the Napoli Airport that are forever in my heart.

NEVER IN MY LIFE did I think I would connect with EVERY SINGLE PERSON! I have made lasting friendships and have even gotten together with a few besties from the trip since.

I can't wait to book my next adventure with SYB!

reviews.name: mike carrillo
reviews.text: SYB Almafi was incredible and one of the most beautiful places I’ve ever been! The memories and experiences I’ll treasure for life. Epic boat day, incredible tour thru Pompeii, exploring Positano, cliff jumps and spritz o’clock at every stop were just a few of the highlights. Got some great workouts in too! Made lifetime memories and friends on the trip. Thank you!
